properties.title: Quiet cedar cabin steps from the lake
properties.description: Peaceful waterfront cabin surrounded by trees. Ideal weekend escape with strong short-term rental potential in summer. No highway noise; kayak launch nearby.

properties.title: Bright downtown loft near nightlife
properties.description: Open-plan loft above busy restaurants and late-night venues. Walk to offices and transit. Great for investors targeting young professionals who want city energy.

properties.title: Four-bedroom suburban family home
properties.description: Spacious house on a quiet cul-de-sac with a fenced yard and highly rated schools. Long-term tenant demand from families; not a vacation rental play.

properties.title: Modern riverfront retreat with dock access
properties.description: Contemporary home on a quiet river bend with a private dock, large deck, and strong appeal for outdoor lovers. Popular with travelers seeking nature and recreation without giving up comfort.

properties.title: Walkable condo near cafes and transit
properties.description: Light-filled condo in a mixed-use neighborhood with cafés, grocery stores, and transit all within a short walk. Attractive to renters wanting convenience, low maintenance, and easy access to downtown.

properties.title: Rural farmhouse with acreage and workshop
properties.description: Classic farmhouse set on a larger lot with a detached workshop, open fields, and room for gardening. Best suited to buyers who value privacy, land, and a slower-paced lifestyle over walkable city access.
